name: Carlos Ramirez
bio:
Carlos's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for mechanics, fueled by his grandfather's auto repair shop in Guadalajara. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics, and volunteered at local racing events, quickly realizing his passion lay in bridging the gap between engineering data and driver feedback. Carlos sees the test driver coordinator role as vital, believing precise data and clear communication are key to optimizing vehicle performance and ensuring driver safety. 

He's known for his meticulous approach, spending hours analyzing telemetry and preparing detailed reports. His dedication to accuracy and his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable insights make him a valuable asset to any racing team. He is eager to prove his worth and make a significant contribution to a team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Carlos is of average height with a focused, intelligent gaze.
